plan.summary: Documents the new `retries` option in docs/guide/requests.mdx. The change adds Tabs imports and a Retries section with per-language examples (TypeScript and Python) in tabs.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change in one MDX file. It has no runtime code. The imports must resolve in the docs theme.
plan.storyArc: One docs page gains a Retries section. The imports enable the tab components, and the section uses them to show the option per language.

topics.title: Retries section with per-language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: How does the guide document `retries`? The Tabs and TabItem imports at the top enable the tabbed examples in the new Retries section. Verify the TabItem elements have only `value` and no `label`, and that the imports are valid for the docs theme.
